amendment.boost_rule: cut check and evaluation steer at boost x the selected strength; calibration and selection unchanged
amendment.gain_rule: evaluation with the link's write after the steered block at gain x its trained size (tanh(alpha) there times gain, both readers); every other exchange, calibration and selection unchanged
amendment.reuse_rule: directions, calibration, selection and cut check copied from an earlier run at the same layer, geometry and boost (all link-cut, so the gain cannot change them)
amendment.direction: difference of means with neutral-only sink mask
amendment.sink_rule: exclude the four largest neutral-energy coordinates only if together they carry >=95% of energy
amendment.scale: positive minus neutral mean projection on the fitted unit direction
amendment.unit: one natural mean projection gap along the unit difference direction
amendment.selection: original mention/fluency rule, smallest passing candidate; original fallback
amendment.unchanged: texts, all-token injection, scoring, controls, counts and statistical tests
